query.ejb-ql: SELECT DISTINCT OBJECT (o) FROM ScheduledHearing o, Hearing o2 WHERE o.notBeforeTime >= ?1 AND o.notBeforeTime <= ?2 AND o.addHearingUsed = 'Y' AND o2.hearingId = o.hearingId AND o2.courtId = ?3

SELECT DISTINCT OBJECT (o) FROM ScheduledHearing o, Hearing o2 WHERE o.notBeforeTime >= ?1 AND o.notBeforeTime <= ?2 AND (o.addHearingUsed is null OR o.addHearingUsed = 'N' OR o.addHearingUsed = ' ') AND o2.hearingId = o.hearingId AND o2.courtId = ?3
SELECT OBJECT (sh) FROM ScheduledHearing sh WHERE sh.sittingId = ?1
SELECT OBJECT (sh) FROM ScheduledHearing sh WHERE sh.notBeforeTime = ?1 AND sh.sittingId = ?2
SELECT OBJECT (sh) FROM ScheduledHearing sh WHERE sh.hearingId = ?1
SELECT OBJECT (sh) FROM ScheduledHearing sh WHERE sh.linkedSHId = ?1
SELECT OBJECT (s) FROM Sitting s, IN (s.scheduledHearings) AS sch WHERE sch.hearingId = ?1
SELECT OBJECT (s) FROM Sitting s WHERE s.courtSiteId = ?2 AND s.courtRoomId = ?3 AND s.sittingTime >= ?1
SELECT OBJECT (s) FROM Sitting s WHERE s.listID = ?2 AND s.courtRoomId = ?3 AND s.sittingTime >= ?1
SELECT OBJECT(o) FROM Hearing o WHERE o.caseId = ?1
SELECT OBJECT(o) FROM Hearing o WHERE o.linkedHearingId = ?1
SELECT OBJECT(o) FROM HearingList o WHERE o.courtId = ?1 AND o.startDate = ?2
SELECT OBJECT(o) FROM HearingList o WHERE o.courtId = ?1 AND o.startDate = ?2 AND o.listType = ?3
SELECT OBJECT (e) FROM DefHearingRecord e WHERE e.hearingRecordId = ?1 AND e.version = ?2
SELECT OBJECT (e) FROM DefHearingRecord e WHERE e.defendantOnCaseId = ?1 AND e.hearingId = ?2
SELECT OBJECT (e) FROM DefHearingRecord e WHERE e.defendantOnCaseId = ?1
SELECT OBJECT(o) FROM ScheduledHearingAttendee o WHERE o.scheduledHearingId = ?1
SELECT OBJECT(o) FROM ScheduledHearingAttendee o WHERE o.refJudgeId = ?1 and o.shAttendeeId = ?2
SELECT OBJECT(o) FROM ScheduledHearingAttendee o WHERE o.shStaffId = ?1
SELECT OBJECT(o) FROM ScheduledHearingAttendee o WHERE o.refCourtRepId = ?1
SELECT OBJECT(o) FROM ShJudgeBean o WHERE o.shAttendeeId = ?1
SELECT OBJECT(o) FROM ShJustice o WHERE o.hearingId = ?1 order by o.shJusticeId asc

SELECT OBJECT(o) FROM LegalAidAmendment o WHERE o.legalAidOrderId = ?1 AND (o.obsInd is null OR o.obsInd = 'N' OR o.obsInd = ' ')AND (o.amendmentType = 'COUNSEL' OR o.amendmentType = 'SOLICITOR') order by o.legalAidAmendmentId desc
SELECT OBJECT(o) FROM LegalAidOrder o WHERE o.defendantOnCaseId = ?1 AND (o.obsInd is null OR o.obsInd = 'N' OR o.obsInd = ' ') ORDERBY o.legalAidOrderId DESC
SELECT OBJECT(o) FROM LegalAidOrder o WHERE o.caseProsAgencyId = ?1 AND (o.obsInd is null OR o.obsInd = 'N' OR o.obsInd = ' ') ORDERBY o.legalAidOrderId DESC
SELECT OBJECT(o) FROM LegalAidOrder o WHERE o.defendantOnCaseId = ?1 AND (o.dateOfRevocation is not null OR o.obsInd is null OR o.obsInd = 'N' OR o.obsInd = ' ') ORDERBY o.legalAidOrderId DESC
SELECT OBJECT(o) FROM LegalAidOrder o WHERE o.caseProsAgencyId = ?1 AND (o.dateOfRevocation is not null OR o.obsInd is null OR o.obsInd = 'N' OR o.obsInd = ' ') ORDERBY o.legalAidOrderId DESC

SELECT OBJECT(o) FROM LeoAdvLink o WHERE o.defendantOnCaseId = ?1 AND o.refAdvocateId = ?2 AND o.legalAidOrderId = ?3 AND o.crestPostNumber = ?4 AND (o.obsInd is null OR o.obsInd = 'N' OR o.obsInd = ' ')
SELECT OBJECT(o) FROM ShLegRep o WHERE o.scheduledHearingId = ?1
SELECT OBJECT(o) FROM ShLegRep o WHERE o.scheduledHearingId = ?1 AND o.legalRole = ?2 AND o.solFirmOrRefLegalRep = ?3
SELECT DISTINCT OBJECT(l) FROM ShLegRep l, ScheduledHearing s WHERE l.refLegalRepId = ?1 AND l.scheduledHearingId = s.scheduledHearingId AND s.notBeforeTime BETWEEN ?2 AND ?3 AND s.hearingId = ?4
SELECT OBJECT (shd) FROM SchedHearingDefendant shd WHERE shd.defOnCaseID = ?1
SELECT OBJECT (shd) FROM SchedHearingDefendant shd WHERE shd.scheduledHearingId = ?1 and shd.shLegRep is empty
SELECT OBJECT (shd) FROM SchedHearingDefendant shd WHERE shd.scheduledHearingId = ?1
SELECT OBJECT (shd) FROM SchedHearingDefendant shd WHERE shd.scheduledHearingId = ?1 AND shd.defOnCaseID = ?2
SELECT OBJECT (e) FROM ExportA e WHERE e.exportAId = ?1 AND e.version = ?2
SELECT OBJECT (e) FROM ExportA e WHERE e.hearingId = ?1 OR e.linkedHearingId = ?2
